name: Deformation Propagation Registry
purpose: Formalize how projection distortions spread through reconstruction neighborhoods and corridors.

propagation_classes.definition: Deformation that remains contained within a single projection-aspect role.
Deformation that spreads along a recoverability corridor but does not affect the broader neighborhood.
Deformation resulting from the attempted erasure of projection conflicts, spreading distortion to adjacent domains.
Rapid, non-linear spread of distortion resulting in widespread metadata decay.
Propagation that specifically target the distinctions between projections, inviting identity collapse.

candidate_distortions.definition: Forcing concurrent aspect roles into a linear causal sequence.
Reduction of multidimensional aspect roles into a single priority view.
Treating high accessibility scores as if they were source-relation evidence.
Use of unification terms that omit mandatory conflict-preservation metadata.
Omission of embedded-observer constraints in propagation analysis.

governance_rules.rule: Every deformation propagation must identify its primary distortion mode and risk class.
Cascade-level propagation triggers an immediate REJECT_ESCALATION of dependent research claims.

forbidden_claims: Deformation propagation proves physical entropy increase.
Propagation gradients derive physical wave propagation laws.
Localized deformation justifies the assumption of partial ontology identity.
